# Synth
Synths are synthetic humanoids - machine bodies running a sapient mind. They are Palmtree's replacement for the IPC species, and their bodies can be reshaped with markings to look like almost anything.
## Benefits
- 50% faster than humans; their legs are built for speed. - Three times as durable as a human (300 critical / 600 dead). - Immune to poison, asphyxiation and cold, and resistant to brute damage. - Does not need to breathe. - Drinks and eats anything - reagents are metabolized without any effect. - Heavier than most species, which noticeably slows anyone trying to drag them.
## Drawbacks
- Takes increased heat and shock damage. - Uses coolant (Oxidant) instead of blood, and is repaired rather than treated by medical.
## Special
- Their whole appearance comes from markings: cybernetic limbs, robot antennae and screen faces, species adaptors and everything else the marking library offers.
